$comment: Session handling. The SDK never holds a merchant API key: the merchant backend calls POST /payment/{serviceId}/mobile-sdk/session and hands the short-lived mobsdk_ token to the app through a session provider. Tokens live in memory only and never appear in logs, errors, descriptions or bridge payloads.

provider.singleFlightMeaning: Concurrent requests needing a session share one provider call.
provider.providerErrorMessage: Only the error type name; the provider's message is never forwarded.
provider.integratorCodePassThrough: A provider may throw a SimPay checkout error with its own code; it is reported unchanged.
provider.androidToday: Provider exceptions become internal; concurrent 401s refresh once per request.

rules: expiresAt is converted to a remaining duration once, when the session is received; afterwards only monotonic time counts, so changing the device clock has no effect.
A session is refreshed proactively refreshMarginSeconds before it expires.

A session whose expiresAt is already in the past by the device clock is still used for minimumReuseSeconds, so a wrong device clock cannot cause a provider call per request; the API answers 401 if the token really expired.
Without expiresAt a session is used until the first 401.
expiry.androidToday: expiresAt is ignored; refresh only after 401.

unauthorized.note: Repeating a POST after 401 stays disabled until SimPay confirms that 401 guarantees no side effect.

staleUnauthorized: A 401 answered to an older session never invalidates a newer one.
